Hi PH, we’re Scrap Brain Audio. We’re mostly curious whether the idea behind 2G holds up.

Most music software keeps getting cleaner and more capable. We went the other way on purpose: a low sample rate, a speaker that compresses and rings, only four voices. Would you want limits like that in the tools you use, or do they get in the way once the novelty wears off?

four voices and a little speaker that rings is a very specific kind of limitation lol

being able to load your own audio makes that interesting beyond the first generated sound
